name: B10-0531/2025 (PPE) – Escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Iran for its growing persecution of the Baha'i religious minority, a group of about 300,000 people. It asks Iran to stop discrimination, release all Baha'is held for their faith, stop seizing their property and cemeteries, and let Baha'i students attend university. It also calls on the European Union and its member states to keep raising this issue in talks with Iran and to consider more sanctions. This is the Parliament's position and request; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks Iran to free detained Baha'is and stop property seizures; no law changes.
- It affects Iran's Baha'i minority, especially women, students and detainees.
- Next, the EU and member states are urged to raise this in talks and consider sanctions.
